title: Mobile Engineer (React Native)
text:
Sprout Banking is a mobile-first bank for teenagers and their parents.

You will
- Build features in React Native and TypeScript for iOS and Android.
- Write native modules in Swift and Kotlin when needed.
- Integrate with our GraphQL API and Firebase for push notifications.
- Write tests with Jest; automate releases with GitHub Actions.
- Care about performance, accessibility and secure storage of user data (OAuth, biometrics).
- Collaborate in Figma with design and in Jira with product.

You have
- 3+ years building mobile apps, at least 1 with React Native.
- Comfort with Redux and REST APIs.
- Experience shipping to the App Store and Google Play.
- Fintech experience is a plus.
